_comment: The eager (index-*.js) chunk's gzip ceiling, in BYTES. This file is the single
source of truth: it used to be prose in a docs/BACKLOG.md row, raised and
recorded by the same person, with no mechanical check in either direction.
It was raised twice in two PRs before anyone could notice.

(what infra/docker/Dockerfile.api sets). A build without it is ~860 B LARGER
and is not what ships — that discrepancy already made one reviewer report a
wrong figure. scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs asserts the mode rather than
Raising this number is a deliberate act: say why in the PR body, and expect to
